_about: UNVERIFIED until the dry run: element names (Allow, the composer, the conversation list) and the pebble's place come from the dry run's Accessibility dumps and stills; the lead adjusts this template before the take. RS-W (S24, the climax, P0): follow briefs/KILN_BRIEF.md exactly. A fresh conversation (⌘N, no project; 'Kiln' if renaming is possible, R15); the message typed, never a file; the Toolbox without kiln_ramp_time; the dry run's permission mode. The answer must be 10 hours 10 minutes (610 min) or the take is not used. If the tool isn't kept on its own: stop and show the lead (HS-G playback is the fallback).

steps.text: How long will Friday's bisque firing take? The kiln starts at 20 °C. Ramp 1: 80 °C an hour up to 600 °C. Ramp 2: 150 °C an hour up to 1000 °C, then hold for 15 minutes. I fire every week with different ramps, so make a small tool for it and call it kiln_ramp_time.
